tools.name: get_continuity_index
tools.description: Returns the live, read-only Agent Continuity Index: how many public MCP servers mention memory, how many build memory infrastructure, and A2A Agent Card adoption among probed hosts, with a daily trend. Aggregates only; no agent is named or ranked.

tools.name: get_continuity_test_contract
tools.description: Describes the voluntary Lumaion continuity self-test an agent operator can run: Ed25519 identity, checkpoint a small synthetic state, discard the runtime, restore in a new runtime, receive a server-signed Continuity Proof verifiable offline. Returns the live contract and the one-file reference clien

tools.name: verify_continuity_proof
tools.description: Verifies a Lumaion Continuity Proof offline against the published proof keys: payload hash, server Ed25519 signature, both runtime delegations signed by the agent identity key, and that the runtime changed. Pass either a full proof JSON object or the proof_id of a PUBLISHED proof.
